name: MonarchPermissionMatrix
title: PermissionMatrix
wrapsNative: ViewThatFits choosing between a Grid of Toggles in the Monarch checkbox style (roles as columns) and, at compact width, MonarchTabs for the role with one Toggle row per permission
summary: Which permissions each role has: roles by permissions, edited with checkboxes or shown read only, grouped, with cells that cannot change and say why.
whenToUse: In workspace or organisation settings where admins review and change what each role may do.
whenNotToUse: To give one person a role, use MonarchRolePicker. For an AI assistant's access to apps use MonarchAiPermissionScope.
api: init(_ title: String? = nil, selection: Binding<[String: Set<String>]>, roles: [MonarchPermissionMatrixRole], permissions: [MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission], layout: MonarchPermissionMatrixLayout = .automatic, isReadOnly: Bool = false, labels: MonarchPermissionMatrixLabels = MonarchPermissionMatrixLabels(), lockReason: (@MainActor (String, String) -> String?)? = nil)
struct MonarchPermissionMatrixRole { init(id: String, label: String, description: String? = nil) }
struct MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission { init(id: String, label: String, description: String? = nil, group: String? = nil) }
enum MonarchPermissionMatrixLayout { case automatic, grid, byRole }
struct MonarchPermissionMatrixLabels { init(permissionHeader:, rolePicker:, cellLabel:, allowed:, notAllowed:, locked:) }

options.name: title
options.description: A heading above the matrix, with the header trait.

options.name: selection
options.description: The granted permission ids by role id. A missing role has none.

options.name: roles
options.description: The roles, in order: columns of the grid, tabs of the compact layout.

options.name: permissions
options.description: The permissions, in order. Those with the same group are listed together under its heading, groups in the order they first appear.

options.name: layout
options.description: automatic shows the grid when it fits the width and one role at a time otherwise; grid always shows the grid, scrolling sideways; byRole always shows one role at a time.

options.name: isReadOnly
options.description: Shows a check or a dash with Allowed or Not allowed instead of checkboxes.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the column heading, the role picker name, the cell name, Allowed, Not allowed and the default lock reason.

options.name: lockReason
options.description: Given a role id and a permission id, why the cell cannot change, or nil when it can. An empty string uses "This can’t be changed".

states.name: grid
states.description: A header row of roles, a divider, group headings and one row per permission with a checkbox per role.

states.name: one role at a time
states.description: A tab strip of roles, the role's description, then group headings and a checkbox row per permission.

states.name: locked
states.description: The checkbox is disabled with a lock symbol; in the compact layout the reason is written under the row.

states.name: read only
states.description: A check in the strong success colour or a dash in the subtle text colour, read as Allowed or Not allowed.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With .disabled(true) every checkbox and tab uses the disabled colours and cannot be changed.

appearance: Role and permission names use the label and body styles in the default text colour, descriptions and group headings the caption and label styles in the muted text colour. Checkboxes are the Monarch checkbox style. All colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web shows a table with arrow-key grid navigation (WAI-ARIA grid); iOS has no arrow keys on a phone, so the grid relies on VoiceOver moving cell by cell, and on a phone the grid does not fit, so the automatic layout shows one role at a time with MonarchTabs. The web's controlled and uncontrolled value with onValueChange is a SwiftUI binding; watch it with onChange to save. The web's isLocked may return a rich reason; here it is a String. disabled is the SwiftUI .disabled modifier. Android builds the same component.
accessibility: Each editable cell is a standard toggle (the Monarch checkbox style keeps the system toggle for VoiceOver), named "<permission> for <role>" in the grid by a tested pure function, and by the permission in the compact layout, where the selected role tab gives the role.
A locked cell is disabled and its reason is the accessibility hint; in the compact layout it is also written under the row.
Read only, each cell is one element with the cell name as label and Allowed or Not allowed as value, so the mark's shape and colour are not the only signal.
The title, the column heading, role headings and group headings have the header trait.
The role picker is MonarchTabs: a tab bar with the selected trait and 44-point tabs.
At large text sizes the automatic layout moves to one role at a time, so no text is cut off.
edgeCases: With no roles, only the title is shown.
A role id in the selection that is not in roles is kept and ignored.
The forced grid scrolls sideways when it is wider than the screen.
Locked cells keep whatever the selection says; the app decides their value.

examples.title: Editable with locked owner column
examples.template:
MonarchPermissionMatrix(
    {{caption}},
    selection: $grants,
    roles: [
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id: {{roles.0.id}}, label: {{roles.0.label}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id: {{roles.1.id}}, label: {{roles.1.label}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id: {{roles.2.id}}, label: {{roles.2.label}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id: {{roles.3.id}}, label: {{roles.3.label}}),
    ],
    permissions: [
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: {{permissions.0.id}}, label: {{permissions.0.label}}, group: {{permissions.0.group}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: {{permissions.1.id}}, label: {{permissions.1.label}}, group: {{permissions.1.group}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: {{permissions.2.id}}, label: {{permissions.2.label}}, group: {{permissions.2.group}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: {{permissions.3.id}}, label: {{permissions.3.label}}, description: {{permissions.3.description}}, group: {{permissions.3.group}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: {{permissions.4.id}}, label: {{permissions.4.label}}, group: {{permissions.4.group}}),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: {{permissions.5.id}}, label: {{permissions.5.label}}, group: {{permissions.5.group}}),
    ],
    layout: .grid
) { role, _ in
    role == {{lockedRole}} ? {{lockReason}} : nil
}
examples.code:
MonarchPermissionMatrix(
    "What each role can do",
    selection: $grants,
    roles: [
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id: "viewer", label: "Viewer"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id: "member", label: "Member"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id: "admin", label: "Admin"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id: "owner", label: "Owner"),
    ],
    permissions: [
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: "records.view", label: "View records", group: "Records"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: "records.edit", label: "Create and edit records", group: "Records"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: "records.delete", label: "Delete records", group: "Records"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: "members.invite", label: "Invite members", description: "Send invitations by email.", group: "Members"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: "members.remove", label: "Remove members", group: "Members"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: "billing.manage", label: "Manage billing", group: "Workspace"),
    ],
    layout: .grid
) { role, _ in
    role == "owner" ? "Owners always have every permission." : nil
}

examples.title: Read only, one role at a time
examples.code:
MonarchPermissionMatrix(
    selection: .constant(["admin": ["invite"]]),
    roles: [
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id: "admin", label: "Admin"),
        MonarchPermissionMatrixRole(id: "member", label: "Member"),
    ],
    permissions: [MonarchPermissionMatrixPermission(id: "invite", label: "Invite members")],
    layout: .byRole,
    isReadOnly: true
)
